description.value: The Haney branch (store #65) is part of the province-wide BCLIQUOR government retail chain, offering wine, spirits, beer, ciders, and non-alcoholic products. It is one of 198 stores operated by the BC Liquor Distribution Branch across British Columbia. Touring cyclists passing through Maple Ridge could use it as a beverage resupply point.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 22m; rack at 37m.
